ground_truth.title: Building Department
ground_truth.main_content:
Department Function

The function of the Building Department is to promote public safety by enforcing building standards. Building Department services include:

- Building permits - Permits authorize construction and inspections.
- Contractor licensing - Contractors and sub-contractors must be licensed, bonded, and insured to work in the City of Portage.
- Inspections - Construction is inspected for conformance with the plan, the permit, and with state and local building codes.
- Plan review - Construction plans are reviewed for compliance with state and local requirements.

Typical Projects Requiring Inspections

- Building
- Electrical
- HVAC
- Plumbing

Typical Activities Requiring a Permit

- Carports, Change of Use, Concrete pads, Decks, Detached Garages, Driveways, Exterior/interior remodeling
- Mobile Homes, New building construction, Occupancy Permits, Parking lots, Pool, Porches, Roofing
- Room additions, Sheds, Sidewalks, Signs and Awnings, Windows and Siding
